questions.question: On a mechanical drawing, what does a scale of 1:50 mean?
options: 1 mm on the drawing equals 50 mm in real life
50 mm on the drawing equals 1 mm in real life
The drawing is 50 times larger than actual size
questions.explanation: A 1:50 scale means the real object is 50 times larger than the drawing.

questions.category: A4 — Use technical instruments and testers
questions.question: What instrument is used to measure gas pressure in inches of water column?
questions.explanation: A manometer measures low gas pressure, commonly in inches of water column.

questions.category: A5 — Use codes, regulations, and standards
questions.question: Which document is most likely to specify legal requirements for gas appliance installation?
questions.explanation: Gas codes and regulations establish legal safety requirements for installation and service.

questions.category: A6 — Organize work and maintain records
questions.question: Why should gas pressure test results be recorded?
options: To replace the need for inspection
To document work performed and support compliance
questions.explanation: Accurate records help prove testing was completed and support safe, traceable work.

questions.question: Complete combustion of natural gas requires fuel, heat, and:
questions.explanation: Oxygen is required for combustion. Air supplies oxygen for gas burning.
